name: Stifle's House
description:
Home with a Black Jaguar 2021 ftype and Black Breakout 2024 117 Harley parked in the drive way.  It is the tallest building in the vicinity, and next to a municipal building about a block away.  It is only a few blocks away from the a beach.  The color of the outside of the home is a dark gray with white and black accents with a modern square shaped design.

Inside at the entrance is a small pond in the hallway. To the right rooms and stairs , to the left 3 rooms and a large kitchen with wicker basket lamps hanging down. The colors are neutral , gray , offwhite and blacks with green houseplants along some of the hall and dining room near the kitchen.  There are some paintings and prints framed and hanging along the hallways including artists such as J.M.W. Turner, a Deviant Artist named 'Furboy', Lane Brown and a local artist. 

The kitchen has a large gray granite center table with a stove inside  it. The walls in the kitchen are light gray with no windows. You see many appliances and seasonings on the counter, ice cream machine, air fryer, waffle iron, blender, toaster, stand mixer.

A door to a darkened room with neon signs lighting the area with a turntable, microphone, synthesizer, electric drum kit, recording equipment some amps and a computer desk and chair with a soundboard connected to it.

Another room  there is x cross with restraints, bar spreaders, cat o nine tails, riding crop, a queening chair, handcuffs , duck tape, lots of rope, a tantric chair, sensual oils in small containers, and a queen size bed.  A light smell of incense and lavender fills the room.  The walls are velvet red with black accents.

Another door downstairs to a home gym with thick padded blue floors , off-white padded walls, with a section for free weights, a cycle machine, and a bench press. Another corner for the gym room has gis, towels and hand wraps for Brazilian Jujitsu. 

A room in the downstairs to a minimalist white and dark brown decor room with a bed, dresser, desk and TV, and mini fridge.  It appears lived in with a bag beside the bed with various women's clothing and unmade bed.  Upon closer inspection of the desk you see papers that appear to be environmental science topics, likely college  classwork.

Room to a small roll with a fabric table, and a Mannequin, sewing machine, a section with soldering iron, computer parts , magnifying glass,  and various fabrics.  There is a big window in the back of this room with open light gray curtains that shines light throughout the day.

Another door downstairs to a spacious game room with a large round dark  wooden table at the center with a couch and TV with video game consoles, bookshelves with ttrpg games such as vampire the masquerade, dungeons and dragons, rifts among others. 

Up the stairs. A Brown Buddha statue next to a private pool with dark gray walls, we get to the 2nd floor The whole master bedroom and bath is the 2nd floor. The walls are a soft yellow granite.  The bed is king size off white. The room decor is Minimalist with black accents. 

The master bath includes a Jacuzzi, a large glass enclosed shower with gold trim and porcelain bathtub with light tan walls , mirrors , clear exposed light bulbs along the sink, with light gray tiles group with several Persian rugs with a toilet

Leading up the stairs to the third floor it is open air.  It is the roof of the home. It has a very large pool, several benches, patio lawn furniture, tables, tiki torches and paper lanterns decorate the roof. A simple chain link fence around it. There are even several white linen beds here with drapery for privacy.  There is a small section with archery targets and Yumi bows and arrows.  It is the tallest building in the surrounding area and provides privacy.
author: Stifle
lore: A small plaque is written at the door: The home of Vita and Stifle.
